member.name: T:ConDmsLockerCmd.LockerController
member.summary:
Low-level RS-485 locker controller. Protocol: 9600 baud 8N1, BCC = XOR of all payload bytes.
Commands: Unlock single : 8A [board] [lock] 11 [BCC] lock = 0x01–0x32 (1–50) Check single : 80 [board] [lock] 33 [BCC] lock = 0x01–0x32 (1–50) Read all : 80 [board] 00 33 [BCC] Unlock multi : 90 [board] [S1][S2][S3][S4][S5][S6][S7] [BCC]
NOTE: Board may prepend garbage bytes before the real response. Real response always starts with the command head byte (0x80 or 0x8A). ParseResponse() strips any leading garbage before the expected header.
